channel.title: Securing the Ledger: A Board-Level Guide to Post-Quantum Migration for Corporate Finance
channel.description: Quantum risk has moved from research curiosity to active regulatory mandate. With the G7 roadmap published in January 2026, the EU, UK, and ASD timelines clarified, and the BIS Project Leap proving feasibility at the central-bank level, the question for boards is no longer whether to migrate — it is whether the migration can be completed before the cryptographic shelf-life of today's data expires.

item.title: Securing the Ledger: A Board-Level Guide to Post-Quantum Migration for Corporate Finance
item.description: A board-level view of post-quantum migration in corporate finance in May 2026, covering the G7 roadmap, BIS Project Leap findings, NIST ML-KEM and ML-DSA, and a three-phase logical migration path.
